Active Health still holds #1 on the query with their own /christchurch/osteopathy/ page's ACC-registered messaging. gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. Confirmed again 2026-09-18: content depth + freshness remain the dominant differentiator against blog-post-heavy competitors like osteopath-christchurch.com (headaches / migraine / cranial / baby / arthritis), MK Osteopathy (TMJ), headachetendon.nz (chiropractor, though its 3+ week #1 on 'lower back pain christchurch' was DISPLACED this run by Better Health), and triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz's cross-body-region expansion into arthritis / back-pain / neck-pain / concussion via dedicated landing URLs. Meridian's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure (PR #108) is the closest thing we have to blog cadence — one entry per month, homepage-surface only, not a separate URL. Item #14 covers the full blog build. **STRONGEST-EVER EVIDENCE 2026-09-18**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ reached **#1** on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' this run — the FIRST TIME any Meridian URL has ever held #1 on a tracked query. This proves definitively that dedicated, indexable, schema-marked condition URLs with citation-ready intros (#31) and structured list blocks (#34) can reach the very top in this market, not just top-10. Combined with the sports-injury-recovery URL's return to #4 the same week, the URL-per-condition thesis is validated across two pages and multiple SERP positions (#1, #4, #5, #6, #9). Item #14 (blog collection built on the same infrastructure) is the highest-leverage path to more ranked URLs and remains **Tier 1**. Cloudflare's 15 Sep AI-crawler default further raises the leverage of owned Q&A content (ad-supported publishers being shut out of AI training crawlers means models will lean harder on primary-source clinic sites).

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit is a major AI-citation source but the platform mix shifted sharply in the Jul-Aug window. UNCHANGED 2026-09-18: no material movement in the Reddit-Perplexity litigation / licensing situation since 31 Jul motion-to-dismiss rejection. Between Jul 1 and Aug 19, 2026, Perplexity supplied 71% of tracked Reddit citations while ChatGPT supplied 23%; ChatGPT Search citations linking to Reddit fell from ~250/day in early Aug to 16/day the week after Aug 14 — a -94% decline in six days. Reddit's Perplexity share is now ~24%, Gemini 0.1%. Item #15 stays on the backlog scoped to Perplexity-visibility only (larger share, smaller more curated source pool means single well-structured posts can surface); skip the ChatGPT-oriented seeding. 90/10 rule still applies: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.why: Unlikely to move your rankings. Google has kept this feature in test mode for years, and a large 2026 study found that adding this kind of behind-the-scenes code gave no real lift. It's cheap, but a good one to dismiss.
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. DOWNWEIGHTED 2026-08-07: Ahrefs schema-impact study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) held up in late-July commentary; consensus is schema is a context signal, not a lever. Speakable specifically has been in beta 7 years without leaving beta. REINFORCED 2026-09-04: Ahrefs' 1,885-page schema study was finalised — pages that added JSON-LD schema between Aug 2025 and Mar 2026 vs 4,000 controls showed NO MAJOR UPLIFT in AI citations across Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT. The Feb 2026 Fischman study (730 AI citations, 75 commercial queries, health included) found the dominant predictor of AI citation is Google organic rank position: position-1 pages cited in 43% of queries. **UNCHANGED 2026-09-18**: no new schema.org release (v30.0 from March 2026 still current); no lift evidence emerged this window. Keep on the list because it's still cheap, but do NOT invest engineering time in schema-type expansion over body-copy / condition-page work.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.why: Up-to-date review numbers on your own site help visitors trust you, but they don't change your Google ranking by themselves. Getting new Google reviews (#16) is what moves rankings. It also needs a paid Google Places key set up first.
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report now names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor (reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month per Epicware July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend, so review freshness feeds both the Local Pack AND the AI-citation layer. Combined with #16, this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end — bump up in effective priority even though tier stays 2. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: no new counter-signal; the AI-Mode local pack now often shows just 1-2 businesses instead of 3 (Sterling Sky tracking cited across SEL coverage through this window), which increases the relative importance of any recency-tied slot. UNCHANGED 2026-09-18: no material Sterling Sky / Whitespark / BrightLocal update this window.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.reviewer: the practitioner who writes each post
items.why: The Christchurch clinics that rank for specific conditions mostly do it with one helpful article per condition, and your own condition pages show the idea works here too. It's the biggest job on the list, and every post needs a practitioner to write or check it.
files: PR #108 Practitioner Spotlight infra can be extended rather than a from-scratch build
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed 2026-08-07: 70% of AI Overview cited pages churn within 2–3 months (Search Engine Journal July 2026 AI-Mode-after-one-year study); pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns TMJ the same way. **DEFINITIVE EVIDENCE 2026-09-18 — LEVERAGE FURTHER ELEVATED**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ reached **#1** on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' this run — the FIRST TIME any Meridian URL has ever held #1 on a tracked query, displacing triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz from #1. Combined with the sports-injury-recovery URL's return to #4 the same week, the URL-per-condition thesis is validated across two pages and multiple SERP positions (#1, #4, #5, #6, #9). This is the strongest-possible proof-of-concept: condition-URL-per-post can hit #1 in this market, not just top-10. STARTING POINT: PR #108's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure — the Decap collection config, JSON-LD, homepage surface and image handling can be adapted rather than built from scratch. **ADDITIONAL TAILWIND 2026-09-18**: Cloudflare's AI-crawler default went live 15 Sep — as ad-supported health publishers shut AI training crawlers out, models will lean harder on primary-source clinic sites + GBP for local health answers. AI Overviews respond to 68% of local searches (Semrush) and position-1 organic CTR fell from 1.41% to 0.64% on pages where an AIO appears (Ahrefs, -54% effective drop) — traditional-organic-only strategy is losing yield, so the AI-citation angle matters even more. Consensus in Aug-Sep commentary: depth > velocity — 2 posts/month is fine if each is genuinely useful.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions (Perplexity-oriented)
items.why: Reddit mentions mainly help with the Perplexity AI search tool, which few NZ patients use. Time-consuming and hard to measure, so low priority.
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. POSTURE REBALANCED 2026-09-04: Between Jul 1 and Aug 19, 2026, Perplexity supplied 71% of tracked Reddit citations while ChatGPT supplied 23%; ChatGPT Search citations linking to Reddit fell from ~250/day in early Aug to 16/day the week after Aug 14 — a -94% decline in six days. Reddit's Perplexity share is now ~24%, Gemini 0.1%. This rebalances the pitch: (a) target Perplexity-visibility as the primary win — Perplexity's citation pool is smaller and more curated, so a single well-structured Reddit answer can surface in Perplexity answer cards if it directly answers the query; (b) treat ChatGPT-visibility as a bonus, not a target, given the current decline (though it's recovered from similar drops earlier this year — may return); (c) ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot at 16.28% vs 9.74% (Cloudflare July 2026), and Claude's Reddit-indexing path is a separate open question. UNCHANGED 2026-09-18: no material movement in Reddit-Perplexity litigation or licensing this window (motion-to-dismiss rejection 31 Jul still stands). If Reddit tightens access to Perplexity too, this lever narrows further. Recommend acting in the next 60 days. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge + personalised response SLA
items.why: Regular new Google reviews, answered within a day or two, are one of the best-proven ways for a local clinic to rank higher in Google Maps results.
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor. Reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month (Epicware / DigitalApplied July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend — freshness now compounds across Local Pack AND AI citation. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end. UPDATED 2026-09-04 — response-cadence discipline added: Whitespark 2026 now tracks owner response within 48 hours as a separate behavioral signal (89% of consumers expect businesses to respond to reviews; 81% expect a reply within a week; next-day expectations climbed to 32% from 18% a year ago). BrightLocal 2026 consumer survey: 50% of consumers are actively put off by generic or templated review responses. Recommendation refined: (a) same-week response as a hard floor, (b) 24-48hr target for freshness weight, (c) response text must be PERSONALISED (name the specific practitioner or treatment the reviewer mentioned; avoid template language). **REINFORCED 2026-09-18**: AI Mode leans on the same GBP + review corpus that Whitespark ranked #1, so this item now has compound value — every review nudged and every personalised response text feeds both the Local Pack signal AND the AI Mode / AI Overview citation layer. Effective leverage stays high even without a fresh study this window.

items.title: Build an /acc/ landing page — Active Health / osteo.co.nz own ACC queries
items.why: People search for ACC osteopaths, and two nearby clinics now have dedicated ACC pages. Your condition pages have started ranking (estimated), so the same one-topic-per-page approach should work here. ACC wording is sensitive (see July's rewording), so Nina should check it.
items.body: **URGENT 2026-09-18 — COMPETITIVE WINDOW CLOSING**: betterhealthosteopathy.nz/acc/ NEW to #2 on 'osteopath acc christchurch' this run — Better Health has just shipped a dedicated /acc/ landing page, which is exactly what this item proposes. Active Health still holds #1 with /christchurch/osteopathy/. This means the competitive window for #25 is closing: shipping now slots Meridian behind two entrenched competitors; delayed further, we face a third. The 'acupuncture acc christchurch' side of this query saw major SERP churn last run with burwoodacupuncture.co.nz taking #1 and koruhealing.co.nz new to top 5. We have ACC pricing scattered across the site but no single indexable /acc/ URL. PR #113 rewrote all site-wide ACC copy from 'we lodge claims for you' to 'ACC-registered provider' framing after Google Ads disapproved the clinic under the 'Government documents and official services' policy — the /acc/ page must follow the same discipline. Describe (a) that Meridian is an ACC-registered treatment provider (osteopathy — Nina Hu; acupuncture — Min Jin); (b) the current ACC subsidy amount and what a patient pays out-of-pocket; (c) that no referral is required to book; (d) an explicit non-affiliation line with a link to acc.co.nz (matches PR #113's disclaimer for the manual Ads-review reviewer). Do NOT describe the mechanics of claim filing on the patient's behalf. Passage-level extraction still matters (88% of health queries trigger AI Overview, 83% zero-click per July 2026 SEJ healthcare-AI data) — a tight 40–60 word intro block per item #31's pattern should lead the page. Effort remains S.

items.body: First check 2026-05-22 of 'concussion osteopath christchurch' showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz at #1, osteo.co.nz/concussion/ at #2, triskelionosteopathy.co.nz/concussion/ at #3. The smallest fix is a /conditions/concussion/ page mirroring the existing pattern (sciatica, neck-pain, back-pain, headaches-migraines, pregnancy-back-pain, sports-injury-recovery): MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro (per #31's pattern), structured 5–7 item list blocks (per #34's pattern), acute-vs-chronic / when-to-seek-urgent-care / ACC eligibility (matching PR #113's provider-status framing, not claim-filing mechanics) / how osteopathy fits / book-now sections. Add corresponding entry to conditions.json (including the `lists` array structure introduced in #34) and a tile in the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Page pattern exists to copy; effort S. **The pregnancy-back-pain #1 ranking this run is definitive precedent** — condition-page URLs with the full pattern can hit #1 in this market.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + capture baseline — DO THIS WEEK
items.why: Free data straight from Google on how often your site appears in AI Overviews. Connecting Search Console to this dashboard (setup guide) gets you most of the way there.
items.body: **PROMOTED TO TOP MOVE 2026-09-18 — 'DO THIS WEEK'**: The Gen AI Performance Report reached full worldwide rollout on 31 Aug 2026. All sites can now see impressions inside AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Discover AI features by URL / country / device — still impressions-only (no CTR, no prompt data), but the panel is globally live and 2–3 weeks is minimum viable sample. This is now the highest-leverage cheap first move on the backlog. Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode. UPDATED 2026-08-14 — the report is impressions-only — no CTR, no clicks, no query data (per Aug 2026 write-ups from Pragma-Code, Weblumino, TJ Robertson, SmartTeam); the July 'CTR added' note was either premature or rolled back. The report is still worth enabling (AI-surface impressions remain the only first-party AI-visibility signal we can get), but the end-to-end 'AI-surface → click → booking' attribution story pairs with the STANDARD Performance report's existing CTR column, not the Gen AI panel. **UNBLOCKED 2026-09-18**: previously the panel was opt-in default with a 17 Jun opt-out toggle, and we couldn't be sure the panel had rolled to this property; now the 31 Aug full-worldwide rollout is confirmed. Action items: (1) verify meridianosteopathy.co.nz is a verified property in the clinic's GSC account, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is still ON, (3) screenshot the report's default 3-month window as a 'pre-blog' baseline (~3 weeks of clean data now available) before item #14 ships, (4) build the AI-surface-attribution story on standard Performance-report CTR paired with the GA4 booking_completed event added in PR #116, using the Gen AI impression trend for the same URL set as diagnostic overlay. Use the SEJ CTR-loss diagnostic framing ('stable rankings + stable impressions + falling CTR = AI Overview click loss'). **INTERPRETIVE NOTE**: the August 2026 Google Core Update finished rolling out 21 Sep 2026 (26-day rollout); wait until ~22 Sep+ before drawing strong conclusions from rank changes in the standard Performance report. No code changes needed.

items.title: Add a postpartum recovery section or dedicated /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page — thin SERP opportunity
items.why: Very few Christchurch sites cover postpartum care, so there's little competition. Kaylee lists pregnancy & postpartum as a special interest, and your pregnancy back pain page is the closest example of a page that ranks (estimated).
items.body: First-run check 2026-08-14 of 'postpartum osteopath christchurch' (US-variant of postnatal) returned only 6 total Google results — betterhealthosteopathy.nz, osteo.co.nz, osteopath-christchurch.com and 3 aggregators. Second check 2026-09-04 confirmed the thin-SERP pattern held: still ~5-6 results with bambinoosteo.co.nz (Auckland) + porthillsosteo.co.nz new to visible results. **THIRD CHECK 2026-09-18 CONFIRMS**: still ~5-6 total results with Better Health, osteo.co.nz, osteopath-christchurch.com, porthillsosteo.co.nz — bambinoosteo.co.nz dropped from visible results this run. Three-consecutive-week thin-SERP confirmation is now robust — this is a durable opportunity, not a one-run anomaly. **STRONGER ARGUMENT 2026-09-18**: the pregnancy-back-pain #1 ranking this run is direct precedent that the condition-page pattern can reach the very top on pregnancy / postnatal intent. A /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page shares the same audience and would benefit from adjacent-page internal-link authority. Two implementation options: (a) EXTEND — add a 'Postpartum recovery' H2 section to the existing /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ page with US-spelling variants in body copy (postpartum, postnatal, post-birth) and appropriate MedicalCondition JSON-LD updates, keeping single-page authority (**RISK**: the pregnancy-back-pain page just hit #1 — do not dilute its focus); or (b) NEW PAGE — /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ following the standard condition-page pattern (MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro per #31, structured list blocks per #34), separate URL to catch the exact-slug search intent. **Option (b) is now STRONGLY indicated given the pregnancy-back-pain #1 win — do not risk that URL's focus, ship a fresh URL instead.** Add a tile to the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid.
